get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific territory.

Semantic search across the data PG:AI holds for your accounts — public filings and news, your uploaded materials, web pages, jobs, technologies, contacts, conversations, insights and more. Use `scope=organisation` to search every account tracked for your workspace, or `scope=companies` to restrict to a comma-separated list of `company_ids`. Returns a ranked `{ items, total, page, per_page }` envelope (organisation scope additionally includes `resolved_company_count`).

200.description: Success — `{ items, total, page, per_page }` (and optionally `resolved_company_count` for organisation scope)

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Search scope: `organisation` (all tracked accounts for the org) or `companies` (explicit `company_ids`).

parameters.name: company_ids
parameters.description: Required when scope=companies: comma-separated company UUIDs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page index for the response envelope.

parameters.name: per_source
parameters.description: Page size. Default 25, maximum 50 on all list endpoints. Omit to use the default; increase up to 50 only if you need larger pages. Applied per vector source.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: ISO 8601 lower bound on result date.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: ISO 8601 upper bound on result date.

Poll enrichment or bulk jobs using the public_operation_id (op_*) returned from async POST endpoints.

Ranked relevance signals for a single company — recent material changes, leadership moves, funding, product launches, hiring trends, technology mentions and strategic shifts — drawn from PG:AI insights, public filings and news, web pages, jobs and technologies. By default uses a material-changes query; pass `q` to override. Returns `{ items, total, page, per_page }`. `GET /companies/{company_id}/graph` is a legacy alias for this endpoint.

200.description: Success — `{ items, total, page, per_page }` envelope
